findings.issue: REQ-SAG-0013 says a key MUST NOT be attached to a request to a plain-http host that is not loopback. Its last acceptance criterion also says 'no request to such a host carries a key'. The plan enforces this only in sc-agent-config::load(), where key_env on a non-loopback runner becomes config.key_on_plain_http. The public path is not guarded. LocalBackend::new(kind, &RunnerHost, port, model, key: Option<ApiKey>) (a-6:181) takes any RunnerHost with a key. SystemOneBackend::local(base, key) takes any base, and a-6:265 says 'over http or https'. a-5's Endpoint::parse_local accepts plain http for any host, and nothing in a-5 refuses a SecretHeader on it. A library caller, or any test that builds LocalBackend directly, can send a Bearer key in clear text to 10.0.0.5. Neither a-5 nor a-6 has a test for this, so the request-level AC is not verifiable.
findings.required_correction: Add the guard where the request is built. Either HttpRequest/Endpoint refuses a SecretHeader on a plain-http endpoint whose host is not loopback (new HttpError variant plus an a-5 test), or LocalBackend::new / SystemOneBackend::local refuse the key and host pair (new LocalError variant plus an a-6 test). Add REQ-SAG-0013 to the requirements list of the sprint that gets the guard, and cite the test as the 'no request carries a key' AC.

findings.issue: REQ-SAG-0014 applies to every input, but only the decide path is specified and tested. Test 26 and AC a-10:516 are decide-only: request_bytes, read_batch and read_image. sc-agent-py send takes request: &str and images as in-memory Vec<u8>, and send_batch takes Vec<BatchItem>. The plan does not say whether the 8 MiB request limit, the 10,000 line and 256 MiB batch limits, or the 20 MiB image size are enforced on that path (the image count and size checks are in DecisionRequest::new). No pytest or Rust test shows the typed error from Python.
findings.required_correction: State that sc-agent-py goes through the same decide::build_request / read_batch checks, including limits on in-memory strings and byte images. Add a Python-path test that sends 10,001 items and an over-8 MiB request and expects SagError decide.limit_exceeded. Cite it under REQ-SAG-0014.
